## Executive Summary

A Science Bachelor degree holder in economics & finance of Politics & Economic School, University of London. Experienced in tutoring & teaching English 1 on 1 by achieving clients' academic goals through personalised course programs. Producing & Proofreading academic English learning materials while keeping track of my clients' progresses and maintaining a good client dynamic. I was able to help clients get a 7.0 IELTS score. I am skillful in using Microsoft software including Word, Excel and Powerpoint to boost my productivity. Besides English, I am also procifient in Mandarin Chinese and Cantonese.

```{r, classes}
skill_section <- ".skills-section {
  width: min(100%, 900px);
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 24px;
  color: #000;
  font-family: Arial, 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}"

skill_grid <- ".skills-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 24px 40px;
}"

skill_item <- ".skill-item {
  min-width: 0;
}"

skill_name <- ".skill-name {
  margin-bottom: 9px;
  color: #000;
  font-size: 16px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  font-weight: 600;
}"

progress_bar <- ".progress-bar {
  width: 100%;
  height: 8px;
  overflow: hidden;
  background-color: #e5e5e5;
  border-radius: 0;
}"

progress_fill <- ".progress-fill {
  display: block;
  height: 100%;
  background-color: #000;
  border-radius: 0;
}"

progress_20 <- ".progress-20 {
width: 20%;
}"
progress_40 <- ".progress-40 {
width: 40%;
}"
progress_60 <- ".progress-60 {
width: 60%;
}"
progress_80 <- ".progress-80 {
width: 80%;
}"
progress_100 <- ".progress-100 {
width: 100%;
}"

media <- "@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .skills-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: 20px;
  }

  .skills-section {
    padding: 20px 16px;
  }
}"

```

```{r, skill func}
skillItem <- function(skill, level) {
  box::use(htmltools[tags], dplyr[case_when, between])
  
  # browser()
  stopifnot(inherits(skill, "character"))
  if (length(level) == 1 && between(level, 1, 5)) {
    if (inherits(level, "double")) {
      level <- as.integer(level)
      warning("level is coerced into an integer")
      if (!inherits(level, "integer")) {
        stop("level expects an integer or a double")
      }
    }
  } else
    stop("level expects a single integer/double that is between 1 and 5.")
  
  progress_class <- case_when(
    level == 1 ~ "progress-20",
    level == 2 ~ "progress-40",
    level == 3 ~ "progress-60",
    level == 4 ~ "progress-80",
    level == 5 ~ "progress-100",
  )
  
  progress_pct <- case_when(level == 1 ~ 20,
                            level == 2 ~ 40,
                            level == 3 ~ 60,
                            level == 4 ~ 80,
                            level == 5 ~ 100)
  
  tags$div(
    class = "skill-item",
    tags$div(class = "skill-name", skill),
    div(
      class = "progress-bar",
      role = "progressbar",
      `aria-label` = skill,
      `aria-valuenow` = progress_pct,
      `aria-valuemin` = 0,
      `aria-valuemax` = 100,
      tags$span(class = paste("progress-fill", progress_class))
    )
  )
}
```
